integrity: All proof claims are analytic; exact arithmetic and finite numerical checks are diagnostics. Relevant source articles and preprints are cited, and one related 2024 full-text source was accessible only in material author-posted excerpts.
scientific_limitations: Undelayed two-dimensional ODE with strictly positive coefficients and initial populations and real \(p\geq1\) only. No delay, diffusion, nonpositive starts, singular parameter values or global formulas for trajectory-dependent constants. Other equivalent published results cannot be ruled out by a bounded literature review.
title: A sharp blow-up boundary and prey-derivative trichotomy in a generalist predator flow
